column1: # The KatWork CLI and web builds leave the WebAssembly plug-in host (vectorcraft-plugins, wasmi) out.
# The gated crates themselves: each defaults to the host (an upstream build of the crate alone keeps it).
# heic-rs (the HEVC decoder behind HEIC/HEIF import, gate `heic`).
# vectorcraft-js (the ECMAScript interpreter that runs scripts, gate `scripting`).
